plan.major: Communication - New Media, Branding, and Message Design Emphasis
plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-12 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Communication - New Media, Branding, and Message Design Emphasis program page (Location: Online Campus) and its linked official degree map workbook, 'Communication Degree Maps (2026-2027)', 'New Media, Branding, Message Design (Online)' tab, last updated/reviewed August 7, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official online academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. DISCLOSED map-header contradiction, recorded as printed: the tab is titled a '4-Year Online Academic Plan' while its subtitle reads 'in 3 years (8 semesters)', and the grid itself is a 3-year plan of eight terms (Fall and Spring of Years 1-2, Summer of Year 2, Fall and Spring of Year 3, Summer of Year 3) with no Year 4 terms; the eight terms are recorded in the map's printed order. The map also notes that, at the moment, online language courses are not offered through SUU. Collected as the BS: the catalog prints Total Credits, BA Degree: 120 and Total Credits, BS Degree: 120 as separate lines; the map totals exactly the BS 120 and expressly does not include the BA's 16 credits of one foreign language. The catalog's BS requirement is 12 credits of Math or Science courses (at least 3 credits MATH numbered 1000 or above, excluding MATH 1030 or MATH 1040, and at least 3 credits of Science courses numbered 1000 or above), and the catalog notes a portion of the BS requirement may be met by satisfying General Education requirements; the map does not label BS courses separately. The catalog's General Education block prints only Core Course Requirements (12+ credits) and Breadth Area Requirements (16+ credits) with 'See General Education for course options'; the map's GE rows are recorded as printed. The catalog's Free Electives section prints no fixed figure (the total is determined by the General Education courses taken, degree type, additional credits earned and prerequisite courses needed). Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (15 each) and the plan to the catalog's printed BS degree total of 120. The catalog's curriculum reconciles: Required Core Courses 12 + Emphasis Courses 33 = the printed Curriculum heading of 45 credits, with no separate Electives block on the page; all fifteen named core/emphasis courses appear on the map. The map's Free Electives and Free Upper-division Electives rows total 50 credits; the catalog prints no free-elective total, so that figure is the map's as printed. DISCLOSED catalog inconsistency, not reconciled: every Communication emphasis page's Program Information prints a Communication Composite paragraph (65 credits in Communication, including a Communication Core of 6 and Required Courses of 15 in each of two emphases, plus 29 elective credits) whose 6/15 figures match none of the emphasis pages' own Required Core / Required Courses headings; the Composite program itself publishes no program-specific degree map and was not collected. Program information printed in the catalog: a minimum GPA of 2.5 is required to enroll in the major, a grade of 'C-' or better is required in all courses required for the major and the emphasis, and a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.0.
